description: Aggregate values transcribed from repository experiment records. These are summary plots, not reconstructions of the original pass@k curves or per-response evaluations.

corrected_figure2.description: Complete, corrected evaluations on all 1,064 problems; reported macro scores.

token_drift.description: Marginal token-distribution statistics from 34,048 saved solo responses per arm; no bootstrap intervals.

matrix_control.description: Standard test / 3,072-token evaluation row: base and the policy trained at 3,072 tokens. The 2,048-trained policy is a different condition and is not plotted.

length_protocol.description: Independent 100-update runs from the same base, seed 42, with matched data and optimizer settings; token cost 0.2 times generated tokens divided by response ceiling.

length_results.description: Final-step matrix and RuleTaker test accuracy at matched evaluation budgets, including RuleTaker base accuracy.

qwen3_4b.uncertainty: No uncertainty estimates are available for these transcribed summary values. No error bars are inferred.

accuracy.aggregation: Equal-weight macro average over AMC, AIME, Minerva and OlympiadBench

drift.metric: Jensen-Shannon divergence of the marginal token distribution from base

pilots.uncertainty: No uncertainty estimates are available for these transcribed summary values. No error bars are inferred.
